scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Watercolor of two elderly bearded men in cream robes and rust and olive mantles in a sunlit courtyard. The man at left offers an open hand; the other rests one hand on his chest and extends the other toward a columned Egyptian gateway. Palms rise beyond ochre walls.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The brothers' attentive exchange imagines Moses bearing God's delegated authority and Aaron preparing to be his prophet and spokesman. The courtyard and gestures are artistic choices; this verse does not name a location or describe an audience with Pharaoh. God remains unseen, and Moses is portrayed as human. Their appearances and the architecture are imaginative conventions.
